review_rationale: Add only bounded historical partial Google Drive indexed-scan readback to the existing Source Folders interface. The original Wayfatours older scan page is not copied; the current scan/apply controller remains authoritative. The pure proof checks enrolled site and brand, source and generation, unexpired sealed UI diagnostic checkpoint, latest matching append-only partial-scan Audit receipt, exact indexed counts, normalized content SHA and current registry assets. It rejects newer invalid receipts, foreign scope, stale or incomplete inventory, invalid hashes and absent evidence; the only UI statement explicitly says historical proof is not current Google Drive freshness. Rendering performs a bounded read-only Audit SELECT and does not call the provider, refresh OAuth, start a scan, change Context review, add an Ability, or grant publication. This is source-only CI review; the original 21 Wayfatours conflicts, actual browser behavior, production admission and rollback remain independently blocked.
